title: SEATO combined fire-support demonstration

paragraphs.text: SEATO DEMONSTRATION A combined fire support exercise was conducted by units of Regimental Landing Team Five for military representatives of the Southeast Asia Treaty Organization. The Battalion was the ground maneuver element.
